name: Hymnal Plus
shortDescription: A UK digital hymn player from Hymn Technology for churches without a regular organist. It has programmable recorded accompaniment, hymn indexes and service playlists.
suitableContexts: Churches without a regular organist or pianist
Anglican, Methodist, Catholic and other hymn-led services
Churches that need a portable programmed accompaniment system rather than a desktop presentation package

pricing.summary: Hymn Technology publishes the HT-400 Hymnal Plus player at £2,499 including VAT, plus £18.50 mainland-UK carriage. It includes a core UK repertoire with over 2,880 tunes and 10 hymn-book indexes. Additional repertoire and service options are separately priced.

Obtain current written terms if the church will connect personal data, event information or third-party media to the system.

church-workflow.value: Supplier describes Hymnal Plus as a worship-music solution for Christian denominations and explains its focus on accompaniment where a church does not have a musician or instrument.

published-pricing.value: Supplier publishes GBP prices for the HT-400 player, accessories and additional repertoire, including VAT and mainland-UK carriage information.

product-functions.value: Supplier documents an HT-400 player with core UK hymn repertoire and additional book-index and Psalm Player options; its FAQ also refers to own MIDI files and SD-card storage.

editorial.assessment: Hymnal Plus is dedicated hardware with embedded music software, not a full church-management platform or a conventional lyric-projection application. It is a relevant UK worship option for a hymn-led church that needs consistent accompaniment without relying on a live musician. The substantial up-front cost and repertoire model make a real service demonstration, audio test and copyright review essential before purchase.
bestFor: Hymn-led churches without a dependable regular musician
Parishes that need programmable accompaniment and hymn-book indexes
Churches seeking a self-contained, portable worship-music device
strengths: Detailed GBP hardware and repertoire prices
Core UK hymn repertoire and multiple denominational book indexes
Own MIDI-file and SD-card capability are documented
limitations: It is dedicated hardware rather than a browser, mobile or general projection service
The up-front hardware cost is materially higher than many subscriptions
Repertoire expansion is separately priced and content rights must be understood
The reviewed privacy page does not establish current detailed data-processing or support-contract terms
